verdict.rationale: The docs show dots can connect third-party apps such as Gmail, Google Drive, GitHub, email, calendar and files, either at setup or later. They also say the dot inherits existing ChatGPT app permissions. Nothing describes a browsable directory or catalog of apps and connectors, so only the 'add them' half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented browsable app/connector directory, the breadth of available third-party connectors, step-by-step add-connector docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
